reviews.t: Used it for the 1st day and success...
reviews.x: I applied it on it's own and I could barely tell the smell. First it definitely smelled like a rubbing alcohol... but after few seconds I could tell a scent of luxurience and opulence.  But after an hour I couldn't tell if scent was there or not... So I went to work today and mixed it with CK Be. one spray of CK Be and two sprays of Molecule... I kept getting compliments, so much that it became annoying. I got too many compliments and extraneous attention. Women were just keep leaning towards me

I would typically have given this product a 5 star review all around but something is wrong with the order I just received. I have purchased this perfume from the same seller multiple times and have always been so happy. I fell in love with the real molecule years ago but the price was insane. I tried this on a whim and I couldn’t have been happier. It was EXACTLY the same. All of my girlfriends switched to this after I spread the news of this awesome find. That was until this last order. reviews.t: I realize that this is only two ingredients and it’s very cheap to make on your own!
reviews.x: Molecule 01 is my signature scent! This bottle arrived leaking. Smells ok. Good longevity  I realized I can make my own by just using perfumer’s alcohol and iso-e super so I’ll be doing that now!

reviews.t: This is THE molecule for you!
reviews.x: I bought Molecule 2 first, after watching a YouTube video about boosting fragrances that don't project well.  That one, to me, smelled like cotton candy.  Since these won't break the bank I decided to order Molecule 1 and Holy Moly!  I love that it is a pure molecule - you know how fragrances these days smell very complex?  Well, this is a simple, basic note that to me smells metallic and musky, in a VERY good way!  My nose picks it up very well and it is gorgeous - I will layer my weaker YSL fr

Can't compare this to escentric as I've never smelled escentric. I purchased iso e super simply because I read it helps boost fragrances. I have skin chemistry that just absorbs fragrance. Bleu de Chanel EDP is hardly a skin scent on me in 30 mins. Happily I used this as a base and sprayed my BDC on top of the molecule 01 and the sillage and longevity of the fragrance was noticeably improved. I could still smell it from my chest well after an hour, HUGE improvement. If you have an expensive colo

(This is my dads account, I am his daughter, hence why the title on here is Robert)  I am a very minimalist but feminine woman who is VERY sensitive to smells. Nearly all perfumes for women give me an immediate headache. If its too floral or sweet or fruity or musky I will get a raging migraine. On top of that I generally don't enjoy the scents made for women. I don't want to smell like a bakery or a florist. But I absolutely do want to smell like nature, and this stuff is nature in a bottle. Ce

reviews.t: I should have listened to the 1 star reviews
reviews.x: There is no discernible scent. I have sprayed it on myself and other people to see if it is just me. Nothing! Can’t smell anything. I even sprayed it before working out thinking that would activate the scent. Still nothing. My spouse has an amazing sense of smell and could not smell anything. I basically spent $25 for the emperors clothes. And to top it off this invisible scent can’t be returned. Be warned, don’t be a sucker like me.

Kelly Rippa mentioned this perfume on one of her shows and described it as a very clean scent that she always gets compliments on.  Wow was she is correct!!!!  I took a chance because you just never know if a perfume will smell as good on you as someone else.  I was VERY pleased because from the first spray, I know I was hooked.  I also get compliments every time I wear it.

Smells very similar to Escentric 01, but at a much better price.  I will definitely be buying this again! Update:  After more sampling I actually think this smells BETTER than Escentric 01.  I just wish the spray bottle wasn't so cheap.
LOVE IT. SUBTLE & REFRESHING! Kelly Ripa talked about wearing Molecule 01 on her show & I decided to try it. Love it & keep ordering. Wish it came in a larger container.
Really did not live up to what I was expecting. I was told it would smell like a fresh water scent of a clean shower. It smelled like incense used in a Catholic Church.

Not sure what to say…. I think this performs as-intended, and the spray does allow you to get a good mist allocated.  While putting this under a different fragrance will, to me, slightly change and not simply extend the other fragrance, I do find this interesting.  Though I can see why you can nearly hyperventilate trying to catch a whiff of this.  It’s a bit like a firefly - you just gotta wait for it to show up.  Be attentive…. But there’s no on/off button, per se.  On me, I find it is the ced

reviews.t: Do not buy it smells awful and cant return it
reviews.x: Do not recomend this at all. It literally smells like the pine/christmas tree spray you buy around the holidays. Save yourself some money if you want to smell like a christmas tree just buy the air freshener at walmart for 3 bucks. So disappointed and worst part is you can't return it.

reviews.t: This is my favorite scent by far
reviews.x: This is my favorite scent by far, but have also enjoyed the Sandalwood! Sellers were courteous and emailed me to make sure I was satisfied.

reviews.t: Good, timely service. Disappointed with product, though.
reviews.x: I had previously made a fragrance purchase from a company in Europe and never received my product, so I was apprehensive about this purchase. However, considering the product came from Slovenia to the United States, I would consider the delivery very timely.   The product I received, however, is not nearly as good as the fragrance it is mimicking (molecule 01).  I own the molecule 01 by escentric molecules and this tribute8 version smells nothing like it; in fact, it smells literally like nothin

reviews.t: ISO E Super is a great tool
reviews.x: ISO e super has some great traits.  By itself it has a faint cedar smell and, alone, can make you’re clean skin smell great with sillage, but it’s your own unique skin scent sillage. Just you, but better.  However it’s primarily used as a tool, layered with your favorite fragrance to amp up the performance. I have yet to find a fragrance it doesn’t improve.  I typically use it as a base, but sometimes on top. It improves longevity and helps it radiate.  I love it.  So when I don’t want to use co

I bought this thing in 2019. I have a few dozen very nice fragrances that are all mostly hailed to be crowd pleasers and compliment pullers. But my God, this here either beats them all, or it elevates a few of them (as a combo/mixture) to unreal levels.  I'll make it short and sweet + give you my cheat code compliment puller. It's not my personal favorite to wear, but I wear it just to get the wildest compliments. It intoxicates people! Anyway, it's this here Molecule 01 knockoff spray + Armaf D

It smells like a combo of cedar wood and pine needles to me. A little strong at first spray, definitely makes me cough if I have the bathroom door closed since I'm weak to fragrance anything, but mellows out and lingers as a really nice fresh wood scent. I'm not 100% sure if other people smell it or not since no one's reacted one way or the other but after a couple days of use I really started to enjoy it.  Kind of interested in trying the sandalwood variant of this at some point.

I bought this because someone’s was wearing it and I loved it. I understand that scents are different on everyone, but at least there is a scent. When I sprayed it on, I thought - I’m going to like this. Within minutes, the scent was gone. And it wasn’t that I no longer smelled it. The next day I put in on and went to my husband and asked if he could smell it. His answer “barely. “  So IDK if some formula changed or I got ripped off, but not worth the money.

Smells like mildew or dirty wet plumbing pipes. Thats all I can smell and it doesn't go away. To the point it gives me headaches. I bought it to layer under performing designer fragrances I own, but it overpowers most fragrances I layer with. Its NOTHING like the original Escentric Molecule 01. Maybe I got a bad batch I don't know, but I doubt it. I would not recommend if you are aiming for a clone/dupe of Escentric Molecule 01 or a performance enhancer.

reviews.t: The bottle arrived leaking so badly
reviews.x: This is a second time I ordered this item. The first one came perfect,  no complaints.  I like the smell and how it works.  I definitely was planning to continue to buy it, but the second bottle arrived  so badly leaking and I got just a half of the bottle. Even though the bottle itself look a little different.  It's very frustrating thar for some reason I cannot exchange it or contact the seller directly to letting them know about the issue.

reviews.t: Since 2020 they’ve changed their formula eww
reviews.x: I’ve ordered 11 bottles of this over the years and the last 4 bottles have been pretty bad.  They’ve changed the formula and it smells like a loud cheap cologne but mostly of bug spray.  I kept writing and complaining would fold and give them another chance.  I’d like them to produce a good one again like they did 3 years ago and I would re visit my comments.

reviews.t: Smells terrible. I ordered this on recommendation by someone I ...
reviews.x: Smells terrible. I ordered this on recommendation by someone I trust, but this smells nothing like it is supposed to. Very sad, as I waited a couple weeks for delivery.  Definitely want a refund. In looking at other reviews, I am wondering what exactly I ended up with.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as clean, subtle, and refreshing, and some say they keep reordering.
Several reviewers use it as a base to boost or layer under other fragrances that don't project well.
A notable number of reviewers report receiving leaking bottles or half-empty product, and some say they couldn't return it.
Some reviewers complain there is no discernible scent at all or that it smells unpleasant, like pine or incense.
Reviewers praise the value, noting it smells similar to or better than Escentric 01 at a much better price, though a few mention the cheap spray bottle or wish for a larger size.
